item.subtitle: Designated & Protected Sites / DAERA, Northern Ireland Environment Agency
item.description: Northern Ireland's sole UNESCO World Heritage Site: the Giant's Causeway and Causeway Coast. Inscribed in 1986 under criteria (vii) and (viii) for its outstanding geological and natural features — the famous columnar basalt formations and associated coastal landscape.
